maya (AE): Riverfront wants a quick perf POC next Wed. Target: p95 < 300ms at ~1k RPS single-turn. Can we scope a minimal run?

sam (SalesEng): Which model? lucas?

lucas (Riverfront): 13B quantized preferred. Budget limited. Need defensible numbers.

priya (ML Eng): Quick plan: two options — baseline 4 GPUs (A10G-like) with continuous batching, or buffered 8 GPUs. Load window: 30s warmup, 8m steady, 2m cooldown. We'll report p50/p95/p99, req/sec, tokens/sec, GPU util, batch histogram, KV hit-rate.

chris (Infra): I'll reserve a 4-GPU sandbox now and expand if needed. No VPC for POC.

sam (SalesEng): Priya please paste the k6 command and a one-line cost range for the SOW.

priya (ML Eng): k6 example: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m post-gen.js` (post to /v1/generate). Ballpark infra: 4 GPUs ~$10/hr, 8 GPUs ~$20/hr; add $5-10/hr overlay. Plan 4hr engagement + 6-8h engineer time.

maya (AE): Good. Lucas: approve up to the buffered option?

lucas (Riverfront): Approve buffered if needed. Send runbook and we'll schedule.

deploy-bot: reservation sandbox-dedicated-77 (4 gpus) id rsv-ff12.
